description: Delete one maintenance window; alerts for its monitors resume at once and no tool restores it. To suspend a window but keep it, use update_maintenance_window with enabled false. Requires a key with the write scope. Returns {"success": true}.

window_id.description: The window's uuid from list_maintenance_windows. An id that is not a window of this organization is a 404.

name: delete_maintenance_window
title: Delete a maintenance window
